title: Geometric regularity ascends along smooth ring maps
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of $k$-algebras which is a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Assume $A$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and geometrically regular over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. Then $B$ is Noetherian and geometrically regular over $k$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07QF (lemma-geometrically-regular-goes-up, line 47187) and its proof (Lemma 00T4 base-change-smooth, Lemma 07NF regular-goes-up, with Lemma 0381 for finitely generated field extensions); Noetherianity of $B$: $B$ is of finite presentation over the Noetherian ring $A$ (Hilbert basis theorem), implicit in Stacks since Definition 0382 is for Noetherian algebras
